subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should an explicitly configured SearXNG `baseUrl` that cannot resolve remain authoritative and fail before network access, rather than falling back to ambient `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`?
rationale: Both outcomes are viable compatibility contracts: fail-closed prevents silent routing to a different host, while fallback preserves behavior for deployments that currently rely on a broken explicit reference plus an ambient endpoint.

options.title: Adopt authoritative configured values
options.body: Accept this PR’s fail-closed behavior so a configured-but-unavailable value reports an actionable error and never routes a search to the ambient endpoint.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep today’s fallback semantics for unavailable configured values and close or revise the PR because existing deployments may rely on the ambient endpoint.

options.title: Request a separately designed strict mode
options.body: Defer the behavior change until maintainers choose and document a compatibility-preserving opt-in policy, noting that a new config surface carries its own support cost.

recommendation.title: Adopt authoritative configured values
recommendation.body: Accept this PR’s fail-closed behavior so a configured-but-unavailable value reports an actionable error and never routes a search to the ambient endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion directly requests this compatibility decision from steipete, while the implementation traces back to the SearXNG feature owners.
